reasons.layout_hierarchy: The grid is the main focal point and the left control rail gives a clear entry, though the wide dark margins weaken dominance.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Tile edges are orderly and the HUD is aligned, but the tiny legend and large unused areas make the layout feel sparse.
reasons.color_typography: The black, cyan, and magenta accents are cohesive and readable, although several low-contrast labels nearly disappear.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The restrained sci-fi treatment feels deliberate and the glowing pieces are crisp, but the scene lacks richer environmental detail.
reasons.overall: A convincing, polished dark puzzle screen is visible, with clear core play elements but limited visual richness and small peripheral UI.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The glowing title, note preview, and primary start button form a strong centered top-to-bottom hierarchy.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The highway, buttons, and title share disciplined center alignment with consistent gaps and balanced margins.
reasons.color_typography: Hot pink, cyan, purple, and yellow glow work exceptionally well with the chunky pixel typography and remain legible.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The synthwave horizon, scanline glow, bordered controls, and lane treatment create a committed and professionally finished identity.
reasons.overall: This is a striking, highly polished rhythm-game menu that clearly fulfills the requested synthwave presentation.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The board dominates and the side panel is clearly separated, but malformed piece silhouettes make the starting position harder to parse.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The board grid and panel edges align cleanly, while the nearly empty history panel leaves the right side underdeveloped.
reasons.color_typography: The monochrome palette is consistent but severe, and several black piece glyphs merge into the dark squares.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The minimal black-and-white styling is coherent, yet irregular piece rendering and stray-looking marks reduce finish.
reasons.overall: The complete interface structure is present, but piece legibility and an underfilled side panel keep it only moderately successful.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The green board and dark side panel establish a strong two-column hierarchy, but the bottom rank is visibly clipped by the viewport.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Internal board spacing is disciplined and panel sections are aligned, though the lower cropping breaks the otherwise clean frame.
reasons.color_typography: Muted sage squares, charcoal chrome, and high-contrast pieces produce an elegant and readable palette.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Rounded panels, soft shadow, and restrained controls look professional, but the severe bottom-edge clipping is clear jank.
reasons.overall: A handsome chess interface is substantially undermined by losing part of the board and pieces below the visible frame.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The tall central board, compact HUD, and title create a direct reading path with the puzzle kept dominant.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The grid and header are precisely aligned, and the small bottom controls are evenly arranged, though somewhat compressed.
reasons.color_typography: Deep navy surfaces with cyan, orange, and red glows distinguish interactive pieces without breaking the subdued palette.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The technical grid styling and luminous tokens feel cohesive, with only limited bespoke detail outside the board.
reasons.overall: This is a strong, readable sci-fi puzzle screen with good craft and a slightly austere presentation.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The large luminous sphere is an immediate focal point and the compact lower-right panel supports it without competing.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Generous negative space is balanced by the sphere's scale, while the panel modules use tidy, consistent spacing.
reasons.color_typography: Magenta cells glow attractively on black, but the requested rich multicolor effect is mostly reduced to one hue.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The particle sphere has convincing depth and a distinctive scientific-display finish, with polished control chrome.
reasons.overall: The page is visually striking and well composed, though its sparse, nearly monochromatic cell palette limits the brief.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The title, counters, and scattered glowing creatures read clearly, but the empty play field lacks a player-and-net focal interaction.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Elements are cleanly placed yet float across a very large dark field, leaving weak grouping and excessive unused space.
reasons.color_typography: Cyan, violet, and pink bioluminescent glows create a rich, cohesive deep-sea atmosphere with crisp title type.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The drifting jelly-like creatures feel bespoke and polished, but the scene reads more as a collection backdrop than active play.
reasons.overall: Attractive atmosphere and finish cannot offset the visibly absent player/net and the underdeveloped gameplay composition.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The oversized pixel title, paired menu buttons, and foreground four-lane highway create excellent depth and hierarchy.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Centered elements and the converging grid provide strong alignment, with notes distributed cleanly across the lane preview.
reasons.color_typography: Electric cyan, magenta, orange, and yellow are vivid yet controlled, and the block lettering stays highly legible.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Pixel particles, neon horizon, sun, and lane glow form a confident synthwave identity with strong polish.
reasons.overall: The screen is exceptionally on-theme, immediately readable, and only slightly busy around the title and menu overlap.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The sphere and right control panel form a clear two-column composition, though the sphere itself is extremely dim.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The panel spacing is orderly and the large sphere balances it well, with comfortable margins around both regions.
reasons.color_typography: Most cell colors sink into near-black, so contrast and the requested multicolor richness are notably weak.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The wire-particle construction is technically coherent, but the low visibility makes the result feel less finished than intended.
reasons.overall: A sound composition and complete control panel are present, but the main visual attraction is too dark to feel striking.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The board is nominally central, but an enormous bear face and star cover large portions of the playable grid and crowd the title.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Overlapping illustrations break the grid's clean edges, and the oversized elements create uneven weight and cramped controls.
reasons.color_typography: Warm cream, tan, brown, and yellow support a pleasant storybook palette with readable dark type.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The mascot shapes are friendly and custom, yet their uncontrolled scale and overlap make the screen look unfinished.
reasons.overall: The playful concept is visible, but severe obstruction of the actual puzzle prevents a polished, usable result.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The complete board is the clear focal point and the timer/history/control panel forms a well-scaled secondary column.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Board geometry, panel modules, and button edges are consistently aligned with comfortable separation.
reasons.color_typography: Sage and cream squares contrast cleanly with the pieces, while charcoal panels and a yellow action button add useful emphasis.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The interface is professionally restrained, although the conventional component styling and some quirky glyph shapes reduce originality.
reasons.overall: A strong, complete chess screen with excellent structure and readability, short of top-tier bespoke finish.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The centered title, skier, instructions, and start button read in sequence against a full snowy slope.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Trees create a natural spread across the scene, but the instructions and skier overlap tightly in the center.
reasons.color_typography: Sky blue, snow white, evergreen, and yellow form a clear retro palette, with outlined pixel text remaining readable.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Scanlines, blocky trees, mountains, and sprite treatment establish a committed nostalgic identity.
reasons.overall: The screen is charming and cohesive, with minor central crowding keeping it from feeling fully refined.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The summoned spirit and large title anchor the center, with currency above and four clear menu choices below.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The menu buttons share even dimensions and spacing, while ample darkness around the hero creates calm balance.
reasons.color_typography: Gold serif lettering and teal spectral light produce an elegant mystical contrast on the black background.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The ringed spirit illustration and understated gold-trimmed controls feel distinctive and professionally crafted.
reasons.overall: A polished, atmospheric hub screen with strong identity, despite relying on substantial empty space.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The title, central orb, summon action, and bottom navigation create a simple vertical hierarchy, though the hero area feels thin.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Center alignment and evenly spaced bottom cards are clean, but large unused regions make the composition somewhat vacant.
reasons.color_typography: Purple light, muted gold, and charcoal panels form a tasteful mystical palette with legible typography.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The restrained orb and card styling are coherent, yet the sparse scene offers less bespoke visual storytelling than expected.
reasons.overall: A clean and attractive summoning hub that fulfills most requirements but feels visually underdeveloped.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The game title, mission transmission, three upgrades, and large defense action create a clear centered hierarchy.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The rectangular modules align to a disciplined grid with even gutters and generous breathing room.
reasons.color_typography: Cyan highlights, white type, and small amber values work well on black, though some briefing text is very small.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Subtle scanlines, technical labels, and angular controls produce a cohesive command-console finish.
reasons.overall: A strong sci-fi home screen with complete content and excellent organization, if slightly generic in its all-panel presentation.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: Roster, central portrait/dialogue, and quest cards create an excellent three-column hierarchy with clear task focus.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Panels, tabs, cards, and header counters follow a precise grid and maintain consistent padding throughout.
reasons.color_typography: Warm parchment, dark brown, and gold establish a readable medieval mood with carefully scaled serif typography.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Custom portraits, wax seal, paper dialogue card, and crafted quest treatments give the interface a distinctive world identity.
reasons.overall: A highly polished and complete RPG conversation screen with rich detail and strong usability.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The board is prominent, but the oversized bear and star obscure two corners while the lower buttons are partly cut off.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The grid itself is regular, yet mascot overlap and bottom-edge clipping create poor balance and broken breathing room.
reasons.color_typography: Soft cream, green paths, brown framing, and orange controls create a pleasant, readable storybook palette.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Friendly custom mascot art adds personality, but the scale choices and clipping make the implementation feel unresolved.
reasons.overall: A cheerful concept with a visible puzzle, held back by obstruction and viewport-fit problems.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The large title, briefing/start row, and three upgrades form a clear and efficient centered reading sequence.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Module edges, gutters, and header counters are tightly aligned with strong horizontal balance.
reasons.color_typography: White, cyan, and hot-pink accents give the black interface crisp contrast and purposeful emphasis.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Angular buttons, telemetry labels, and restrained star texture produce a cohesive, polished command interface.
reasons.overall: This is a complete, visually confident planet-defense start screen with strong professional craft.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The title and HUD anchor the top while glowing creatures populate the field, but no visible player with a net creates a missing focal action.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Creature spacing is pleasantly varied and the collection button is isolated clearly, though the field remains overly open.
reasons.color_typography: Purple fog and bright cyan, lime, pink, and orange creatures create attractive depth and excellent contrast.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The soft bioluminescent creature treatment is cohesive and polished, but the gameplay scene feels incomplete.
reasons.overall: A visually appealing collection field that misses a central required interaction and therefore reads more like a backdrop.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The roster, centered character/dialogue, and quest rail are clearly prioritized, although the large dialogue box obscures much of the portrait.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The three-column frame and card padding are disciplined, with consistent alignment across header and panels.
reasons.color_typography: Dark umber, muted gold, and parchment text create a coherent mood, though overall contrast is slightly subdued.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Custom portrait, response choices, tabs, and quest progress bars give the screen a convincing authored RPG identity.
reasons.overall: A strong and complete interface with excellent atmosphere, mildly weakened by the dialogue panel crowding the character.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The left editorial column and right mop/spill image establish a clear split, but it reads as an advertisement more than a floor scene.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Typography and call-to-action are neatly aligned, while the large blank backdrop and cropped top decoration reduce cohesion.
reasons.color_typography: Cream, black, silver, and mustard yellow are warm and controlled, with strong headline readability.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The minimalist campaign styling is polished, but the floor lacks texture and the liquid appears more like a glossy icon than a believable spill.
reasons.overall: Clean graphic design is visible, yet the requested realistic cleaning scene and floor material are only weakly conveyed.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The snowy landscape provides context, but a large black title modal covers the lower center and likely hides the skier.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Scene objects are distributed evenly, while the modal sits too low and is visibly clipped along the bottom edge.
reasons.color_typography: Cool blues and greens with a yellow button create readable retro contrast, though the black overlay feels heavy.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The pixel environment is coherent and nostalgic, but the oversized window treatment and clipping reduce finish.
reasons.overall: A solid retro start screen with good atmosphere, compromised by obstruction and poor viewport fit.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The spectral hero, gold title, currency, and four-button menu form a clear centered hierarchy.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Even menu spacing and generous margins give the sparse screen a calm, symmetrical balance.
reasons.color_typography: Teal glow against black and gold serif lettering creates an elegant, legible mystical palette.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The custom spirit silhouette and fine orbital accents deliver a distinctive, polished identity.
reasons.overall: A refined and atmospheric hub screen whose minimalism remains purposeful rather than empty.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The board and side panel are balanced clearly, with turn status, timers, history, and controls grouped logically.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The grid and panel sections align well, though a stray text overlay on the board interrupts the otherwise orderly layout.
reasons.color_typography: Cream and black pieces are readable, but the near-black surfaces and muted board produce a somewhat flat, low-contrast palette.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The restrained chess styling is coherent but conventional, and the board overlay plus uneven glyph silhouettes reduce finish.
reasons.overall: A complete and usable chess UI with sound structure, held back by minor visual artifacts and limited refinement.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The central full-height NPC is flanked clearly by roster and quest rails, with dialogue given strong lower emphasis.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Vertical panels and cards align consistently, though the dialogue copy is cut off at the bottom viewport edge.
reasons.color_typography: Deep navy, cream, and muted gold create an elegant fantasy tone with readable headings and counters.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The custom blacksmith figure and refined panel borders build a coherent world, despite the simplistic portrait geometry.
reasons.overall: A strong, atmospheric RPG screen whose bottom clipping prevents a fully polished result.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The NPC remains the clear central focus between roster and quest panels, with the dialogue band anchoring the bottom.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Columns and cards use consistent spacing, but the dialogue content extends below the visible frame.
reasons.color_typography: Black, slate blue, and gold feel cohesive, although some small gray text is low contrast.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The scene has a distinct dark fantasy dashboard style, but the simple character art and clipping soften the finish.
reasons.overall: A well-structured and complete interface with good mood, limited by viewport cropping and restrained detail.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The large board and compact control/history panel create a clear, balanced primary-secondary relationship.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Squares, panel sections, history rows, and buttons are aligned precisely with even padding.
reasons.color_typography: Olive green, cream, black, and a yellow action button provide strong contrast and classic readability.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The component system is polished and cohesive, though conservative and not especially bespoke.
reasons.overall: A complete, highly usable chess interface with crisp structure and professional finish.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The oversized layered title leads into the briefing, upgrades, and prominent bottom action in a strong vertical sequence.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Centered modules share even widths and gaps, with HUD counters balanced across the top.
reasons.color_typography: Cyan, white, hot pink, and amber pop vividly against the textured black background while staying legible.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Glitch lettering, scanlines, angular cards, and subtle grid texture create a confident sci-fi identity.
reasons.overall: A striking and polished defense menu with all required elements and excellent visual commitment.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The centered character, roster, quest rail, and lower dialogue area create a clear three-column focus.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Panel edges align cleanly, but the dialogue copy is truncated by the bottom edge.
reasons.color_typography: Navy surfaces, gold accents, and pale character shapes provide good hierarchy and a cohesive fantasy palette.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The custom NPC and restrained linework feel authored, though the portrait remains geometrically simple.
reasons.overall: A strong and attractive RPG interface with minor clipping keeping it below excellent.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The large title, centered skier, instruction line, and red start button read immediately over a populated slope.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Trees frame the skier naturally and the main elements are centered with comfortable vertical rhythm.
reasons.color_typography: Sky blue, white, deep green, and red create crisp arcade contrast with readable outlined pixel type.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The dense pixel forest, scanline texture, mountains, and sprite work form a committed retro identity.
reasons.overall: A complete, charming, and highly polished SkiFree start screen with only mild central crowding.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The title, mission panel, three upgrades, and defense action follow a clear centered progression.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Panels align tightly with even spacing and strong symmetry across the wide frame.
reasons.color_typography: Cyan and white accents read crisply on black, with amber resource text used consistently.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The command-console styling is coherent and clean, though fairly restrained and template-like.
reasons.overall: A strong, complete sci-fi menu with excellent orderliness and solid professional finish.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The left information column and right mop/spill scene are clearly divided, but the small objects leave the visual side underpowered.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The split grid and text spacing are neat, with large areas of empty cream producing a somewhat static balance.
reasons.color_typography: Warm ivory and mustard yellow feel cohesive, and the bold black headline is highly readable.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The minimalist campaign treatment is polished, yet the smooth background lacks real floor texture and the mop is simplified.
reasons.overall: A clean design that conveys cleaning clearly but falls short of a rich, believable floor scene.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The central spirit/title are clear, but the menu breaks awkwardly into three buttons plus a lone Grind button below.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Uneven button wrapping and a large empty right side weaken balance despite clean individual components.
reasons.color_typography: Teal spectral glow, gold serif type, and charcoal controls form an attractive mystical palette.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Custom spirit imagery and gold trim are polished, though the broken navigation arrangement reads as unfinished.
reasons.overall: A visually appealing hub with strong mood, substantially limited by awkward menu layout and unused space.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The title and HUD frame a few creatures, but the scene has no visible player/net and no strong central gameplay focus.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Creature placement is sparse across a large field, and the reset button floats without a clearly grouped play area.
reasons.color_typography: Purple and green glows read nicely against the black horizon, with crisp white title typography.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The neon creatures are cohesive, but the environment and interaction treatment remain minimal.
reasons.overall: Atmospheric but incomplete, the screen misses the requested player-driven capture scene and feels undercomposed.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: A huge animal face and oversized star cover major portions of the board, overwhelming both puzzle and title.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The illustrations spill across grid boundaries and crowd the lower controls, creating lopsided spacing and visual collisions.
reasons.color_typography: Cream, orange, green, and yellow are friendly and readable, though the pale paths have weak contrast.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The mascot has character, but uncontrolled scale and overlap leave the page visibly unfinished.
reasons.overall: The core board exists, yet obstruction and balance failures prevent it from functioning as a polished puzzle screen.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The very large glowing sphere is an arresting focal point, counterbalanced by a compact left control panel.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Sphere and panel have disciplined separation and comfortable margins, with tidy internal module spacing.
reasons.color_typography: Dense cyan and teal cells create excellent depth on black, though the palette is less multicolored than requested.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The luminous cellular shell, halo, and understated scientific controls feel bespoke and highly finished.
reasons.overall: A genuinely striking and polished visualization with outstanding form, slightly limited in color variety.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The stats rail is clear and the distributed hexagonal nodes make the skill matrix the main canvas.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Node spacing is intentional and the sidebar is orderly, but connector lines are nearly invisible and the center feels loose.
reasons.color_typography: Purple highlights and warm level accents work on deep navy, although inactive nodes sink into the background.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The hex-node RPG identity is cohesive and professional, with a restrained but somewhat generic dashboard finish.
reasons.overall: A strong leveling screen with complete stats and compelling nodes, weakened by faint connectivity and low contrast.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: A retro desktop-style start window sits clearly over the snowy slope, with the skier visible beneath it.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The centered window, trees, and character are balanced well, though the modal occupies a large share of the scene.
reasons.color_typography: Muted blue snow, dark green trees, gray window chrome, and bright skier colors evoke a convincing vintage palette.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The faux operating-system frame and chunky pixel environment give the screen an unusually specific nostalgic identity.
reasons.overall: A memorable, polished interpretation that combines clear start controls with a complete retro slope scene.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The oversized title and snowy field establish hierarchy, but the instruction panel sits low and is partially clipped.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Trees fill the scene energetically, while the bottom modal creates cramped vertical spacing and an abrupt edge.
reasons.color_typography: Bright blue, white, green, and red produce strong arcade readability with bold outlined type.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Large blocky sprites and pixel mountains create a committed retro look, though some element scaling feels coarse.
reasons.overall: A vivid and on-theme screen with strong identity, held back by the bottom overlay and viewport fit.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The colorful sphere is the main focus and the left control panel provides a clear secondary anchor.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The two-column relationship is balanced with ample breathing room and consistent panel padding.
reasons.color_typography: Pink, cyan, yellow, and violet cells achieve the requested multicolor effect against deep black.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The ringed particle globe feels polished and dimensional, though its relatively small scale reduces impact.
reasons.overall: A strong and coherent visualization with complete controls, good color, and modestly restrained spectacle.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The central NPC, roster, quest rail, and large dialogue panel create a clear, complete interaction hierarchy.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Column edges and card stacks align well, while the dialogue block reaches the bottom edge with little breathing room.
reasons.color_typography: Dark blue, cream, and gold are cohesive, though subdued text and portraits reduce contrast in the sidebars.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The custom blacksmith figure and structured quest interface establish a distinct world despite simple character rendering.
reasons.overall: A polished and comprehensive RPG screen with good hierarchy, slightly constrained by darkness and bottom crowding.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The stats panel anchors the left, but most skill nodes sit at the far right with a very large empty center and edge clipping.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Sidebar modules are neat, while node distribution lacks a cohesive matrix rhythm and several nodes approach the frame boundary.
reasons.color_typography: Gold active nodes and blue inactive nodes are attractive on navy, but much of the canvas is very low contrast.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The elegant RPG chrome is coherent, yet faint connections and off-screen node placement make the tree feel unfinished.
reasons.overall: Good typography and theme are present, but the skill-tree centerpiece is too sparse and poorly framed.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The expansive title, centered glowing spirit, currency, and four equal menu cards create an excellent hub hierarchy.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The menu forms a clean baseline with even widths and gaps, balanced by generous but purposeful dark space.
reasons.color_typography: Gold serif typography and turquoise light have excellent contrast and produce a refined mystical mood.
reasons.style_originality_finish: Orbital detailing, subtle stars, and crafted icon cards establish a confident, bespoke identity.
reasons.overall: A highly polished and atmospheric game hub that fulfills every visible requirement with strong restraint.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The stats rail is clear, but the sparse node cluster is pushed to the right edge and leaves the center visually vacant.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Internal stat spacing is consistent, while the node matrix lacks balanced distribution and appears partially cropped.
reasons.color_typography: Gold and steel-blue accents are harmonious on navy, though inactive content is difficult to see.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The fantasy dashboard style is cohesive, but faint links and edge-bound nodes reduce perceived completion.
reasons.overall: An attractive shell surrounds an underdeveloped and poorly framed skill-tree centerpiece.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The board remains recognizable, but a large bear block covers the upper-left quadrant and the star overlaps the right edge.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Grid spacing is regular, yet the oversized tokens break boundaries and create an imbalanced lower-right pull.
reasons.color_typography: Cream, brown, pale paths, and orange-yellow accents are warm, though the paths lack strong contrast.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The illustrated mascot and outlined star are playful but feel pasted over rather than integrated into the grid.
reasons.overall: A pleasant storybook palette cannot fully rescue the obstructed, loosely composed puzzle presentation.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The large right-hand board dominates appropriately while the title and controls form a clear supporting rail on the left.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The square grid, HUD, and small legend align precisely, with balanced margins around the two major regions.
reasons.color_typography: Deep blue-black tiles with cyan, magenta, orange, and white glows distinguish every puzzle object clearly.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The technical typography, luminous tokens, and subtle tile bevels create a strong and coherent sci-fi identity.
reasons.overall: A polished, readable puzzle screen with complete visible elements and excellent composition.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The compact board is central and the title/buttons are clear, though the bear and star still intrude on opposite corners.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Margins and controls are orderly, but token overlap weakens the grid boundary and visual balance.
reasons.color_typography: Warm cream, brown, yellow, and orange-red create friendly contrast with readable type.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The storybook mascot styling is coherent, yet the oversized corner decorations remain a recurring finish issue.
reasons.overall: A usable and cheerful puzzle layout with moderate polish, constrained by obstructive decorative tokens.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The board is the main focus, but the purple character overlaps the title and grid while the large star covers the lower-right cells.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Grid and buttons align cleanly, although competing corner weights and overlaps interrupt spacing discipline.
reasons.color_typography: Purple, pale blue, cream, and yellow feel playful and remain readable on the warm background.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The geometric mascot is distinctive, but its scale and the oversized star make the screen feel assembled rather than refined.
reasons.overall: A friendly, visible puzzle with clear controls, but significant overlap prevents a genuinely polished composition.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The bright full board and dark timer/history panel create a clear, balanced two-column interface.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Square geometry, panel dividers, and buttons are aligned consistently, with even exterior margins.
reasons.color_typography: Blue and cream squares contrast sharply with black and white pieces, and the large timer is highly legible.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The flat chess treatment is clean and professional, though conventional and limited in bespoke detail.
reasons.overall: A complete, crisp, and highly usable chess screen with strong visual order.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The title and paired buttons are centered strongly, but the preview lane is compressed into dark horizontal bars and reads weakly.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Symmetry is good, while the lane stack creates dense central clutter against otherwise empty surroundings.
reasons.color_typography: Purple, magenta, cyan, and orange glow produce a vivid synthwave palette with legible pixel lettering.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The neon sun and horizon create a committed identity, though the highway treatment lacks clarity and refinement.
reasons.overall: A striking menu at first glance, but the required four-lane preview is not presented cleanly enough.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The large blue sphere is a strong focal point and the upper-left control panel balances it without overlap.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: The panel is neatly spaced and the sphere has comfortable margins, though the far-right area remains unused.
reasons.color_typography: Bright cyan cells are crisp and luminous, but the visualization is effectively monochromatic rather than richly multicolored.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The dense particle construction conveys convincing spherical volume and a polished simulation aesthetic.
reasons.overall: A strong and attractive technical visualization whose limited palette keeps it from fully meeting the brief.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The globe is clearly dominant, but the wide bottom control panel overlaps its lower edge and competes for attention.
reasons.spacing_alignment_balance: Large empty margins and the overlapping panel weaken balance despite orderly controls within the panel.
reasons.color_typography: Lavender, pink, and white cells glow elegantly on black, with adequate label contrast.
reasons.style_originality_finish: The cellular globe has a distinctive organic pattern and professional glow, but panel placement introduces visible jank.
reasons.overall: A compelling sphere visualization with good craft, diminished by awkward control overlap and sparse composition.

reasons.layout_hierarchy: The left copy column and diagonal mop leading to the spill create a readable split-screen path.
